payload.core_composition_summary: Greedy merging of leaf edges to maximize distinct weights, then tree parity DP to decide if 1 or 3 weights suffice for min.
payload.rationale: mx uses greedy exchange argument to reduce duplicate leaf edges; mn exploits XOR forcing leaf parity, checking with tree DP.
